title: Facilitates the rapid download, wrangling and processing of Earth System Model (ESM) output from the Coupled Model Intercomparison Project (CMIP)
text: hotrstuff facilitates rapid download, wrangling processing Earth System Model (ESM) output Coupled Model Intercomparison Project (CMIP). get started, need download wget scripts chosen CMIP6 repository. use: https://aims2.llnl.gov/search. hotrstuff makes easy : Download, Merge files, Regrid chosen resolution, Slice required timeframe, Change frequency data (e.g., changing monthly yearly), Calculate vertical mean depth-resolved ESMs, Create mean/median ensembles variables, scenarios etc.

title: Facilitates the rapid download, wrangling and processing of Earth System Model (ESM) output from the Coupled Model Intercomparison Project (CMIP)
text: hotrstuff requires Climate Data Operators (CDO) software installed prior use. CDO software collection many operators standard processing climate forecast model data. operators include simple statistical arithmetic functions, data selection subsampling tools, spatial interpolation. hotrstuff leverages power CDO, within R environment. CDO installation can found CDO installer website

what: Calculate temporal mean of specified time period — htr_calc_mean
title: Calculate temporal mean of specified time period — htr_calc_mean
text: function calculates temporal means specified time period using CDO (Climate Data Operators). primarily used calculate baseline climatological means historical climate data, can used anomaly calculations.

title: Calculate temporal mean of specified time period — htr_calc_mean
code: htr_calc_mean(indir, outdir, scenario, year_start, year_end)

title: Calculate temporal mean of specified time period — htr_calc_mean
text: indir Character string. Directory containing merged NetCDF files time-sliced. Files continuous time series created htr_merge_files(). outdir Character string. Directory time-sliced files saved. scenario Character string. CMIP6 scenario process (e.g., "historical", "ssp126", "ssp245"). Use "historical" calculating baseline climatological means. year_start Numeric. Starting year calculating temporal mean (inclusive). year_end Numeric. Ending year calculating temporal mean (inclusive).

title: Calculate temporal mean of specified time period — htr_calc_mean
text: return value. function creates mean files specified output directory "_mean_YYYYMMDD-YYYYMMDD.nc" replacing "merged" original filenames, dates represent start end averaging period.

title: Calculate temporal mean of specified time period — htr_calc_mean
text: function uses CDO timmean operator combined selyear calculate temporal means specified year range. processes files parallel efficient computation large climate datasets. function automatically generates output filenames "mean" year range filename.
